% fancyvrb's \UseVerb under a frame set for every verbatim block: a block
% that sets frame=none has no border, and the saved text after it is
% inline, as in the PDF. Saved text with a text color is red, as in the
% PDF; with a fill color and a rule color, it colors neither the block nor
% its frame. Saved text with frame keys leaves the next block without a
% frame or padding. A color in saved text with command characters is red
% too, as in the PDF.
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{xcolor,fancyvrb}
\fvset{frame=single}
\SaveVerb{v}|uvf-text_a|
\SaveVerb[commandchars=\\\{\}]{cmd}|{\color{red}uvf-cmd}|
\begin{document}
Before the block.
\begin{Verbatim}[frame=none]
uvf-block
\end{Verbatim}
Text \UseVerb{v} more.

Red \UseVerb[formatcom=\color{red}]{v} end.

Filled \UseVerb[fillcolor=\color{yellow},rulecolor=\color{blue}]{v} end.

Inner \UseVerb{cmd} end.

Spaced \UseVerb[framesep=1em,framerule=2pt]{v} end.
\begin{Verbatim}[frame=none]
uvf-after
\end{Verbatim}
\end{document}
